turn1_intro:
You will sort {line_count} short lessons into homes. The homes are listed below, each with a name and a one-sentence definition.

For each lesson, choose one main home from the list. You may also choose one second home from the list, different from the main home, if the lesson belongs there too; if not, write none. Use the home names exactly as written.
turn1_reply_format:
Reply format. Reply with exactly one line per lesson and nothing else: no heading, no numbering, no code block, no blank answer, no extra text. Each line has this form:
LABEL | main: HOME | second: HOME or none
LABEL is the lesson's label (for example L01). After "main: " write exactly one home name copied from the list. After "second: " write exactly one other home name copied from the list, or the word none. Separate the three parts with a space, the character |, and a space. Give every label exactly once.
